commensurability.diagnostic_note: keys.gate_rule names a check, not an observed failure. held_on lists the operative hold reasons; non_operative_facts records checks that do not decide a distinct-question verdict. Stored receipts and settlement rules are unchanged.

study_context.study_scope: Independent fresh-world replication of the approved fixed cold-reader diagnostic. It preserves the six-domain, two-form, complete-careful-English population and exact reader editions. It does not test bare-random wording, learnability, future-trained readers, adoption, or the unapproved larger preservation design.
study_context.boundary: Declared by the experiment’s author. This label neither certifies claim coverage nor changes validity, settlement or readiness. A diagnostic can still expose genuine harm.
study_context.label: Diagnostic investigation

side_overlap_inspection.interpretation: Bank identity is not pair-level overlap. Different digests can contain identical pairs. No URL was fetched; no independence or settlement claim is derived.

stratum_diagnostics.interpretation: Every cell remains load-bearing for reproduction. Adverse cells are published for voters; they do not mechanically reject the aggregate result.

divergence.note: every diverged member runs at q4_k_m and no converged member does — consistent with a quantization-channel correlation (fixable by pool composition), not an architectural one. Heuristic grouping of declared results, not proof.

pin.estimand: Diagnostic fixed-144-world cold-reader complete-careful-English comparison: official equal-form-weight mean of within-form arm-pooled joint exact accuracy deltas. Per-reader and equal-reader within-reader sensitivities remain separate; this is not a bare-random, learnability, future-trained-model, or universal preservation study.

144 wholly fresh semantic worlds cover six domains, 72 per form and 12 per form/domain
each world freezes 2-8 distinct eligible identities, five procedure classes and one common eight-record answer menu
complete careful English uses only the exact contiguous registered per-form mapping span with standalone S replaced by the frozen reference
every answer position occurs nine times per form and both exact readers receive opposite arms on every world with 36/36 balance per form
32 fresh construct-free calibration items are run first with both arms per reader; gap must reach at least 0.5
both exact model digests, answer protocol, sampler settings and current qualification receipts match the source
zero absent, off-option, truncated or transport-fault cells and full yield are required
every adverse, null, disagreeing, supportive or aborted result is retained without retry, reroll or enlargement
fresh item artifact https://paste.c-net.org/wip749bgnv39 remains byte-equivalent to the frozen bank and has zero complete-pair overlap with the source
panel harness emits a measurement (calibration, yield, and protocol gates pass)
filed manifest matches the preregistered clean-run manifest (no transport faults or bound truncations)
